objective: GATE 3F-F IDEMPOTENCY MIGRATION DOSSIER DESIGN. Sin ejecutar DDL ni writes, producir evidencia suficiente para fijar un diseño de migracion minimo, reversible y SQL-first que proteja contra doble cola y doble evidencia de pago. El diseño objetivo debe evaluar: (1) unique filtered guard de una sola queue activa por DecisionPagoID y/o DecisionPagoID+HashOrigen; (2) correlacion durable de Finanzas_Pagos con PagoOrigenQueueID/DecisionPagoID/HashOrigen o una clave de idempotencia generica; (3) compatibilidad con datos actuales; (4) rollback exacto; (5) no incorporar identificadores ERP especificos al esquema generico. No implementar ni autorizar canary.

queries.name: f3f_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3f_queue_active_by_decision
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT DecisionPagoID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1 GROUP BY DecisionPagoID HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3f_queue_active_by_decision_hash
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT DecisionPagoID,HashOrigen,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1 GROUP BY DecisionPagoID,HashOrigen HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3f_queue_active_rows
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS activos FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1

queries.name: f3f_queue_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3f_pagos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3f_pagos_rows
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Finanzas_Pagos

queries.name: f3f_pagos_incoming_fks
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,fk.name AS fk_name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') ORDER BY child_schema,child_table,fk.name

queries.name: f3f_queue_incoming_fks
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,fk.name AS fk_name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY child_schema,child_table,fk.name

queries.name: f3f_existing_idempotency_named_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE N'%Idempot%' OR o.name LIKE N'%PagoOrigenQueue%' ORDER BY s.name,o.name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
Prefer one active queue per authorized decision unless runtime evidence disproves compatibility
A successful ERP write must never be retried blindly after ambiguous result
Finanzas_Pagos durable correlation must be generic and must not hardcode MPRO or SoftRestaurant identifiers
Any proposed unique guard must have a deterministic rollback
If structural guard cannot be safely designed from current evidence, keep CANARY_EXECUTION blocked
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
